comment: Annotations derived from reaction context and common biochemical nomenclature. Family labels expanded (RAS -> HRAS/KRAS/NRAS; MEK -> MAP2K1/2; ERK -> MAPK3/MAPK1; SOS -> SOS1/2). Small-molecule sorafenib treated as chemical. Ras nucleotide states treated as complexes (Ras + GTP/GDP). Inhibitor-bound RAF species (iRaf1, iBRaf, iBRaf_dimer, iRaf1-containing complexes) modeled as complexes including sorafenib. Variants named with prefixes 'nfp'/'nfpi' appear to be modified forms of RAF or SOS in the model; they were mapped to their base protein (RAF1 or BRAF or SOS) based on the conversion reactions. Species with insufficient contextual molecular identity (mE, mEL, mELmEL) were labeled unknown.
